name: Appsmith
description: Low code project to build admin panels, internal tools, and dashboards, integrating 15+ databases.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-appsmith application
services:
  # Service name: app
  # The `app` service definition
  app:
    image: appsmith/appsmith-ce:v2.5.1@sha256:34c0e17ba97cc4c85e1c54ce1fa02c1031d0e6c4aecbe19f8f6daca5a3df53b2 # Docker image to use
    container_name: appsmith # Name of the container
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:80" # Port mapping host:container for HTTP
      - "10443:443" # Port mapping host:container for HTTPS
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/stacks:/appsmith-stacks # Mount volume for app data
    restart: unless-stopped # Container restart policy
